{{Top|leg}}
The '''Pan-Tapani Historical Society''' was a club formed at the [[Mrlsst Trade and Science Academy]] by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Arkeld]] approximately [[8 BBY/Legends|8 BBY]]. It was dedicated to maintaining the independence of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. In reality it was cover for Doctor Arkeld's [[Justice Action Network]] cell.<ref name="LOTE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>

It was secretly funded by [[Brak Dunell|Bel Janius]].<ref name="LOTE" />
